address: 176 route de Montpellier, Les Matelles, 34270, France
bio: Exposed beams set the tone in this converted wine cellar at the foot of Pic Saint-Loup, north of Montpellier. Chef Julien Vahl and Lucie Péneau (desserts and front of house) – both of whom have experience in high-end establishments – have set up shop in a rustic space done out with farmhouse tables and heirloom furniture. Their surprise menu, closely tied to the market and the fish auction in Sète, showcases the produce of the Hérault foothills: Mediterranean rock fish, lamb and Cévennes onions, and herbs from the small kitchen garden. Honest cuisine that is rooted in the terroir.
